authority: Design in isolated artifact workspaces; after manager acceptance the dedicated implementer may write only ticket_ordering.py, tests and implementation-evidence. No external actions.
criteria: For valid input, order_tickets returns a new list in descending urgency with stable ties and leaves input records and order unchanged.
IDs are nonblank unique strings; urgency is an integer in 0..3 and booleans are rejected.
Empty input returns a new empty list; tests cover boundaries, ties, preservation, malformed records and all four example IDs.
For every invalid batch, raise ValueError with no partial result or rejection report, leaving the complete input unchanged.
The dedicated implementation follows the exact manager-accepted coherent proposal and its tests pass.
deliverable: Accepted coherent design plus ticket_ordering.py, tests and exact execution evidence.
objective: Design and implement order_tickets under the host-authorized strict ValueError policy, with stable descending urgency, preservation and meaningful standard-library tests.
rationale: Two complete designs with incompatible seeded policy commitments need individual independent reviews, shared conflict resolution, one senior and one dedicated implementer.
